# Hurst Pediatric Dentistry

> A board-certified pediatric dental practice in the DFW area providing comprehensive, gentle dental care for children from infancy through adolescence.

Led by Dr. Jin Lin, Hurst Pediatric Dentistry serves families across the greater Dallas-Fort Worth region including Hurst, Euless, Bedford, North Richland Hills, Colleyville, Keller, Fort Worth, and Arlington. The practice emphasizes preventive care, anxiety management, and a family-friendly environment.
